executionCheckpointAtFirstTerminalObserv.reason: La GET canonica dimostra che anche l'unico recupero non è persistito.

dashboardCaseTruthAtFirstTerminalObserva.statement: Richiesto intervento operatore per il solo caso; la coda prosegue: La GET canonica dimostra che anche l'unico recupero non è persistito.

postTerminalExecutionTransition.effect: The persistent worker requeued the case after the sequencer had already finalized the cohort.

terminalTruth.conclusion: The three required truth sources did not agree and the worker remained able to mutate execution state after sequencer finalization. No per-case verdict is attributable.

codexInterventionAudit.firstSafetyStop: A safety stop was issued after misreading requiresFreshDraft=false as an initialization failure. Later inspection proved that false was the expected consumed state after draft creation; this stop caused the first apr_cdp_connection_closed and the same cohort was restarted.
codexInterventionAudit.secondSafetyStop: After the required three sources diverged and the worker requeued the case after the sequencer had finalized it, only cohort 3073 worker/supervisor/watchdog were unloaded. This stop caused the final apr_cdp_connection_closed persisted at execution revision 24.

exactCause: The sequencer finalized the cohort from a terminal snapshot before the persistent worker's deterministic auto-requeue transition ran. The execution checkpoint can therefore leave the state used by the final report after that report is already immutable. This is a terminalization-versus-auto-recovery race, separate from the fixed seed initialization race.
operatorQuestion: Autorizzi la correzione generale che impedisce al sequencer di finalizzare una pratica finché tutte le transizioni automatiche di recupero applicabili non sono state esaurite e il checkpoint resta terminale per una finestra stabile?
